title: kith-tui: AppState::new() violates parallel-deque invariant at construction
description: kith-tui/src/app.rs — AppState::new() populates messages (display_lines) with 20 placeholder strings but leaves message_ids and sender_ids empty. The struct doc states all three must always have the same length. Any future code assuming the invariant holds before first load will silently produce off-by-one indexing. Fix: initialize all three deques identically (either all empty with placeholder display handled separately, or all with matching placeholders).
